summary: Team Management (Phase 1) fully verified. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering GET members (shape, auth, non-existent org), POST invite (invalid role 400, no-auth 401/422, pending-invite for new email, existing-member 400), PUT role (invalid role 400, no-auth, only-owner protection), DELETE member (no-auth, only-owner protection). Frontend: Team page loads at /app/settings/team, shows organization 'Two Fungis Finishing' + '1 team member', Scott Marshall listed with Owner badge and Active status + '(you)' marker, Invite Member button visible for owner, modal opens with email input, Owner/Employee role toggle buttons, and Send Invitation button all working. Invitation to a new TEST_ email was submitted, backend returned success and modal auto-closed.

minor.issue: For a platform-admin user (Scott is one), a non-existent organization_id returns 200 with empty members array instead of 404. This is because is_platform_admin bypasses the membership check, but the endpoint never validates that the org actually exists. Not exploitable but inconsistent.

When invited email already belongs to an ACTIVE member, the route raises HTTPException(400) inside a try/except that ALSO catches generic Exception and re-raises as 500. Because HTTPException is re-raised via 'except HTTPException: raise' before the generic handler, this currently works (test passed with 400). But nested logic makes this fragile - a future refactor could accidentally swallow it into a 500 with 'already a member' in body.

integration_issues.issue: Carry-over from iteration_22: transient console error '[CommandCenter] Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' appears once on initial load. Non-blocking - data loads on retry. Same race condition tracked since iteration_19.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In routes/organizations.py get_organization_members, add explicit 404 when the organization row does not exist (currently platform admins get 200 empty for any UUID).
OPTIONAL: routes/organizations.py is now ~970 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the team/invite section into a dedicated router module.
OPTIONAL carry-over from iteration_22: fix the first-paint 'Failed to fetch' race on /app/* routes.

NOTE: The invite endpoint uses SUPABASE auth admin listUsers to check existing users - this is O(n) on total user count. At scale this will be slow; consider using auth admin get_user_by_email or a users lookup by email.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/organizations.py invite_member (line ~578-593) loads ALL Supabase auth users into memory then linear-scans - will not scale. Prefer Supabase admin get_user_by_email or a direct query on the profiles/users table.

routes/organizations.py invite_member does not check whether the invited email already has a pending invitation before inserting a new row (relies on 409 from DB). If the unique constraint doesn't exist, duplicate invitations may accumulate.

routes/organizations.py update_member_role and remove_member allow modifying members even if their user_id doesn't exist in the org - PATCH returns 200/204 even when 0 rows updated. Should verify existence first and 404 accordingly.

routes/organizations.py imports 'from config import config' but relies on config.SUPABASE_URL being set at import time. Any misconfiguration silently returns 'error' from health endpoint but individual endpoints will 500. Consider a startup validation.
TeamPage.jsx uses window.confirm for delete confirmation (line 341) - not tested here but breaks the design system consistency; should use a shadcn/ui AlertDialog.

TeamPage.jsx: MemberActions dropdown allows 'Make Owner'/'Make Employee' only for the OTHER users, but the 'Make Owner' branch is also rendered when member.role !== 'owner' (correct). However 'Make Employee' branch only appears when role === 'owner' AND !isCurrentUser - meaning a non-owner employee currently has no dropdown action other than Remove. This is fine but under-documented.

Backend does not send actual invitation emails (no email service integration) - invite for a new user just persists a row in organization_invitations. This should be highlighted as MOCKED / TODO for actual user activation flow.
seed_data_creation: One pending organization_invitation row created for TEST_ui_invite_<ts>@example.com and one for TEST_invite_<ts>@example.com via the invite endpoint. These accumulate on repeated runs; consider a teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Management page and endpoints are fully functional. /app/settings/team requires the current user to be an active member of the organization. Scott (inbox@twofungis.ca) is the only owner of org a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002 (Two Fungis Finishing). Only-owner protections prevent Scott from being demoted or removed - if you want to test the DELETE / update-to-employee happy path, first invite a second owner via POST /api/organizations/{org}/invite with role='owner'. Note: invite for a brand-new email only inserts an organization_invitations row (no email is actually sent - the email service is not implemented). Invite for an existing Supabase user auto-adds them as an active member.
